info.title: sbtools
info.description: Command-line tool for Azure Service Bus operations: purge DLQ, resubmit messages, diagnose issues, and monitor queues.

commands.name: dump-dlq
commands.description: Export DLQ messages to a JSON file

options.name: --namespace
options.description: Fully qualified Service Bus namespace (e.g., mynamespace.servicebus.windows.net)

options.name: --queue
options.description: Queue name

options.name: --topic
options.description: Topic name

options.name: --subscription
options.description: Subscription name

options.name: --output
options.description: Output JSON file path

options.name: --before
options.description: Only include messages enqueued before this UTC datetime (ISO 8601 format)

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Preview message count without writing to file [default: False]

options.name: --interactive
options.description: Interactive mode: show categories and select which to dump [default: False]

options.name: --merge-similar
options.description: Merge similar DLQ categories using LCS-based clustering (interactive mode only) [default: False]

options.name: --categorize-by
options.description: Properties to categorize by. #Prop for system (falls back to application properties), $Prop for body. Default: #Subject,#DeadLetterReason

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Enable verbose output [default: False]

options.name: --help
options.description: Display this help screen.

options.name: --version
options.description: Display version information.

commands.name: resubmit-dlq
commands.description: Resubmit messages from a dead letter queue back to the main queue

options.name: --namespace
options.description: Fully qualified Service Bus namespace (e.g., mynamespace.servicebus.windows.net)

options.name: --queue
options.description: Queue name

options.name: --topic
options.description: Topic name

options.name: --subscription
options.description: Subscription name

options.name: --before
options.description: Only resubmit messages enqueued before this UTC datetime (ISO 8601 format)

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Preview message count without resubmitting [default: False]

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Enable verbose output [default: False]

options.name: --interactive
options.description: Interactive mode: show categories and select which to resubmit [default: False]

options.name: --target-queue
options.description: Target queue to resubmit messages to (defaults to source queue)

options.name: --target-topic
options.description: Target topic to resubmit messages to (defaults to source topic)

options.name: --merge-similar
options.description: Merge similar categories by replacing parameterized values (GUIDs, numbers) with wildcards [default: False]

options.name: --categorize-by
options.description: Properties to categorize by. #Prop for system (falls back to application properties), $Prop for body. Default: #Subject,#DeadLetterReason

options.name: --help
options.description: Display this help screen.

options.name: --version
options.description: Display version information.

commands.name: diagnose-dlq
commands.description: Diagnose DLQ messages by correlating with Application Insights telemetry

options.name: --namespace
options.description: Fully qualified Service Bus namespace (e.g., mynamespace.servicebus.windows.net)

options.name: --queue
options.description: Queue name

options.name: --topic
options.description: Topic name

options.name: --subscription
options.description: Subscription name

options.name: --app-insights
options.description: Application Insights resource ID (e.g., /subscriptions/.../resourceGroups/.../providers/microsoft.insights/components/...). If omitted, basic diagnostic using dead letter reasons is performed.

options.name: --output
options.description: Output JSON file path (optional, prints to console if not specified)

options.name: --before
options.description: Only include messages enqueued before this UTC datetime (ISO 8601 format)

options.name: --max-messages
options.description: Maximum number of messages to diagnose [default: 1000]

options.name: --interactive
options.description: Interactive mode: show categories and select which to diagnose [default: False]

options.name: --merge-similar
options.description: Merge similar DLQ categories using LCS-based clustering (interactive mode only) [default: False]

options.name: --categorize-by
options.description: Properties to categorize by. #Prop for system (falls back to application properties), $Prop for body. Default: #Subject,#DeadLetterReason

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Enable verbose output [default: False]

options.name: --help
options.description: Display this help screen.

options.name: --version
options.description: Display version information.

commands.name: monitor-queues
commands.description: Monitor Service Bus queue statistics in a live-updating console table

options.name: --namespace
options.description: Fully qualified Service Bus namespace (e.g., mynamespace.servicebus.windows.net)

options.name: --filter
options.description: Queue name filter (wildcards * and ? supported, or contains match)

options.name: --refresh-interval
options.description: Refresh interval in seconds (minimum: 1) [default: 5]

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Enable verbose output [default: False]

options.name: --help
options.description: Display this help screen.

options.name: --version
options.description: Display version information.
